 def transform(grid):
     """Fill each horizontal gap between consecutive 5 cells with 3."""
     out = [row[:] for row in grid]
+    height, width = len(out), len(out[0])
     for row in out:
         marks = [i for i, value in enumerate(row) if value == 5]
         for left, right in zip(marks, marks[1:]):
             for col in range(left + 1, right):
                 row[col] = 3
+    for col in range(width):
+        marks = [r for r in range(height) if grid[r][col] == 5]
+        for top, bottom in zip(marks, marks[1:]):
+            for r in range(top + 1, bottom):
+                out[r][col] = 3
     return out
